whatThisIsFor: A returned verdict outranks an active-owner claim. A lane that has returned is not still verifying, and a family its verifier failed is not awaiting a verdict.
obligationVocabularyNote: The P2V rows record thirteen obligations as strings and two as booleans. Both are read; a third spelling refuses, because reading only the strings turned two passing obligations into failures and doubled the defect count.
supersessionRule: one current verdict per family: the highest-precedence lane wins (factory vf lanes over codex-cloud directories, then higher lane number); superseded rows remain as history with superseded: true

failedObligations.finding: The fee is not stated and no waiver route is stated. The packet says so itself and says why: 'Any filing fee, and whether one applies to this request. Ask the clerk of the court above.' That is an honest refusal to write an unsourced figure into a filing instruction and it is the right instinct, but an instruction to ask the clerk is not the fee being stated. Nothing in the committed evidence establishes the Alaska fee for a Rule 37.6 request, so this is an open source obligation rather than a drafting defect, and no packet lane should invent it.

evidence.instructionText: Two things this packet does not tell you, because they are not established here and an unsourced figure in a filing instruction is worse than none: Any filing fee, and whether one applies to this request. Ask the clerk of the court above.
evidence.whatWouldSettleIt: a sourced Alaska Court System fee schedule entry for a Rule 37.6 request, or a sourced statement that no fee applies

failedObligations.finding: One mapped known prefill is absent from the boundary artifact's bytes. participant.email is mapped to 200-00132 page 1 field "34i" (rect x395.69 y120.55 w174.74 h12.96) in both fixtures. The canonical artifact carries it: packet page 3 holds eight flattened widget appearances, the eighth reading "jordan.reyes@example.org". The boundary artifact carries only seven on the same page and the email is not among them, while the family's own report still records valuesReportedByFinalizer 8 for that document and fixture. The loss is silent — no refusal, no unfittable note, no finding. It is not a policy on long values either: the same boundary email, maria.alejandra.oshaughnessy.whitfield@longmailexample.org, is written and present on packet page 2 (200-00130) and packet page 5 (600-00228) of the same artifact.

evidence.method: Every page of both artifacts was opened and its flattened widget appearance streams decoded byte-exactly in this lane; the counts and values above are read from the PDF bytes, not from reports/actual-writes.json.
evidence.reportTranscriptionObservation: reports/actual-writes.json renders the boundary name as "Maria-Alejandra OShaughnessy-Whitfield", dropping the apostrophe. The bytes are correct: the appearance stream carries 0x92 (WinAnsi right single quotation mark) between O and S. The dropped character is a defect in the report's read-back transcription, not in the artifact, and no obligation is failed on it.

failedObligations.finding: Who must be served, and how, is not stated. The instructions say: "Who must be served, and how. Ask the same clerk who must receive a copy of the petition and by what method. The packet correctly refuses to conflate the prosecutor's signature with service, and correctly declines to invent a rule, but neither a recipient nor a method is stated.
